q: Entropy is an isomorphism invariant in ergodic theory. Two Bernoulli shifts with different entropies are:
opts: Conjugate only if they have the same alphabet
Conjugate if they have the same period
exp: By Kolmogorov's theorem (and earlier observations), entropy is a measurable conjugacy invariant. Ornstein's theorem (1970) strengthened this: Bernoulli shifts are isomorphic if and only if they have the same entropy.
